about_the_game:
INSPECT. SORT. DELIVER.

Get the sheep out of the quarantine zone and decide who can be saved — and who can’t.
ESCAPE THE QUARANTINE

The evacuation doesn’t start on the road — it starts with inspection.
Sheep arrive from infected areas and must be checked before transport. Some look healthy. Some act strange. Others hide it well.

INSPECT THE SHEEP

You and your fellow geese must carefully examine every sheep.
Look for bite marks, listen for strange sounds, watch their behavior.
Not all infections are obvious — and some reveal themselves only later.

SORT AND CONTAIN

Healthy and infected sheep cannot mix.
A single mistake during sorting can doom the entire delivery.
Sometimes, simply placing a healthy sheep next to a sick one is enough to spread the infection.

DELIVER TO SAFETY

Once loaded, the cart must be escorted through the quarantine zone.
Slowly, carefully… or in complete chaos.
Every previous decision affects what happens on the road.

THE CART IS YOUR ALLY

The cart is more than cargo — it’s your lifeline.
It carries the sheep… and your fellow geese.
Stay together inside it — or risk being torn apart outside.

HONK TO SURVIVE

Features

  • Inspect sheep for hidden signs of infection

  • Sort and manage sheep before transport

  • Escort and control a single cart together (1–4 players)

  • Online co-op focused on coordination and observation

  • Physics-driven chaos

  • HONK

content_descriptors.notes: Show violence in graphic nature towards fantasy characters,  non-realistic violence towards human-like characters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 9 64 bits or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 or Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Screen resolution 640*480
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-11600K or Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Screen resolution 640*480

short_description: A co-op adventure about inspecting, sorting, and escorting a cart of sheep through a zombie-filled night.
